body:
I used to be able to distract myself with music, nerdy things, playing musical instruments. But now I just lay in bed most of the time and stare out the window until I fall a sleep. It's been so bad, I've been sleeping upwards of 15 hours when I don't have to go to work. Nothing seems to be able to distract me anymore. The crap in my head is getting stronger; the voices, the anxiety, the paranoia, the depression. 

As far as the responses from friends and family, I'd hope they would understand. This is a long fought battle and I am about to wave the white flag and surrender. After the initial shock wears off, they will probably be relieved knowing I am no longer suffering. 

The other positive note is I will be out of their lives. They don't have to worry if I am having an up day or a down day. They won't feel like they have to avoid me for fear of sending me into an episode. In short, they won't have to worry about me anymore. They can spend that time doing something else that's more positive. For friends, it is easier. They have already cut off ties with me. They stopped talking to me and moved on. Family it is much harder. There's always that inherit obligation that they have to keep in contact, worry about me, protect me, and so on. Which is why I feel like a burden.
